core.headline: Extended detached house on 0.3-acre plot, Beech Avenue
core.summary: Guide Price £850,000. Extended detached house on a 0.3-acre plot in Sevenoaks, with a kitchen/family room, double garage and driveway parking. Freehold, Council Tax Band G, EPC D.
core.listing:
27 Beech Avenue is a detached four-bedroom house dating from 1968, occupying a 0.3-acre plot in Sevenoaks. The property has been extended to create a kitchen/family room and includes a double garage.

The ground floor comprises two reception rooms and an extended kitchen/family room. Gas central heating is installed throughout.

The first floor provides four bedrooms and two bathrooms.

Outside, the property stands on a 0.3-acre plot with driveway parking and a double garage. The rear garden extends to the boundary.

Sevenoaks town centre is within reach, with rail services to London.

Guide Price £850,000. Freehold. Council Tax Band G (Sevenoaks District Council). EPC rating D. Standard construction. Mains electricity, mains water (metered), mains sewerage. Gas central heating. Broadband: FTTC. Mobile signal: good outdoor coverage on major networks. Driveway parking. Building safety, restrictions, rights and easements, flooding, coastal erosion, planning, accessibility and coalfield/mining: none known. Japanese knotweed found in the rear garden near the boundary in 2025; herbicide treatment plan by a PCA-registered contractor in progress, with a 10-year insurance-backed guarantee.
keyFeatures: Freehold, Council Tax Band G, EPC D
Japanese knotweed treatment plan in progress with 10-year guarantee
